verdicts.reason: A scatters the badges as loose fragments around a tiny product: SMALL BATCH floats to the left, the SUNSET SALE ribbon crowds the product's top-right, LIMITED EDITION sits between product and headline, and AWARD WINNING sits alone above the CTA. Its legal block is set as large as the body copy, and the stray red placeholder under the CTA is junk. B has the same faults (legal text too big, a four-line headline wedged against the top edge, a speck-sized product, a tiny ribbon pinned to the can) but groups SMALL BATCH and AWARD WINNING with the CTA, so its pieces read a little more deliberately.
